about.title: About
about.description:
Take your 101 experience to the next level! Calculate scores instantly with this smart assistant that eliminates the hassle of pen and paper, track your match history with detailed statistics, and enjoy fun nicknames earned based on your game performance.

You just focus on your game, leave the rest to the notebook.

americano.rules_text:
Each round requires opening a specific combination.

Ground card: You may take the top discard on your turn. Other players may draw a penalty card to take it (max 3 times).

Joker = 50 pts • Misplay = 50 pts • Cheating = 50 pts
